apps.name: Sega: Crazy Taxi Classic (removed from App Store)
apps.localizedDescription: Crazy Taxi Classic is a mobile version of the popular racing arcade game developed by SEGA. Players become taxi drivers in a large, open-world city where each passenger wants to get to their destination quickly and have fun. Roads are for the weak! Cut corners, take new routes, delight customers with dizzying jumps, knock down anything that interferes with driving, and earn cool rewards for your skills. There are various modes available to diversify gameplay and unlock the full potential of this classic arcade game.
